newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Twelve killed, six hurt in shootout in Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Twelve killed, six hurt in shootout in Philippines.

text.p: Twelve members of the Moslem extremist group Abu Sayyaf were killed and six soldiers wounded in a shootout in the southern Philippine town of Lantawan, military officials said on Saturday.
The wounded soldiers were brought to a military hospital in nearby Zamboanga city early on Saturday, Colonel Lino Lapinid said.
Lapinid said an army platoon on patrol in Lantawan, on Basilan island, encountered the Abu Sayyaf followers on Friday night.
The military accuse the group of a string of attacks, including the burning of a town, in the southern Philippines in recent months.
